ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80:20 high-intensity white to low-intensity black ratio across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white central region; black intensity margins along the trailing edge and distal tips; dark triangular intrusion of black pixels at the fluke-to-peduncle junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; approximately 50-degree angle with a depth of roughly 15% of the total vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 2-10 pixels; distinct larger indentation located at approximately 20% of the distance from the median notch to the left tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward-sweeping convex curves from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, dense clusters of varying brown and white pixel groups at the terminal ends of both the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical and diagonal low-contrast grey pixel streaks visible on the mid-section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular protrusion of heterogeneous textured pixels (barnacles) on the far distal edges of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetric black pigmentation at the base, with a wider distribution of dark pixels extending into the right lobe compared to the left.
